folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B226, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All fourteen SV survey entries, eight MW districts, six IM openings, six CW walks and six EC source seams were read. Majority must name its denominator: represented district/workplace residents, local polity, viewpoint community and global demographics are different claims. Encounter tables and animal-centered stories do not establish sapient worldwide government. Most survey entries are explicitly MEMORY; located secondary/MTL/WN summaries retain their own limits. A municipal scent court, public berth or substrate archive in MW is original proposed content, not newly authenticated franchise law (AD32/AD36).

Keep native nonhuman lives ordinary within their institutions: a locally raised human can already know the signal system, and a new human visitor is not automatically everyone’s first human. Body channels, stock, role, title, license, tenancy and citizenship each have actual suppliers. A scent deed’s readable player text does not grant character comprehension; an interpreter contributes actual time and delivered meaning. The person who can physically perform a job need not have its license, and recognition of a credential does not supply habitat, arrival capacity or bodily means. Fitting accommodation can be prosperous public provision or self-owned support, rather than a compulsory rent tax or human debuff. Free transit or support is valid where a real mechanism provides it.

N37 credential continuity and N38 habitat support remain independent. A changed body can invalidate a particular permit while leaving identity, debt and other rights intact; one clerk does not update every registry. A booked berth has real capacity/term to revalidate before commitment. Passage, supported arrival, recognized credential and executable local work are four operations, not a single world-entry boolean. A district continues through departure and later revisit under its selected instance policy, without assumed mission resets or automatic citizenship from contractor rank. Copies, growth and profitable output can exist through supported means; replaying one settlement does not create another occurrence (AD22).

EC03’s all-start-form restriction and EC06’s human host admission are historical inspected implementation limits to compare with current owners, not canonical species bans. The mobile reedling precedent does not implement rooted governance. Changing names on Village NPCs does not provision an independent actor or world. New council/service writing needs its actual quote, authority, participant/support and receiving consequence; a known module alone does not supply them. B218–B225 retain body, clock, recognition and transition scope without proving these proposed institutions.

The old realm/prestige milestone, ordering and1366-primary proof wording are qualified by current broad scope, Klein/LOTM and Harry direction, current desktop/prose-first composition, AD51 and AD42. MJS1’s two-start workshop is a proposed validation opportunity, not a gate before every civic service or current world route. No district, crossing, license, berth, actual command, source canon or native/persistence proof was added here.
